body:
## Outcome

Make data entry consistent, labeled, and usable across desktop, mobile web, and native keyboards.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M2: React and React Native components · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Implement Field, Label, Input, TextArea, amount/numeric input, and needed search input patterns; use the audited catalog to scope additional controls.
- Specify controlled values, focus/error/disabled/read-only states, descriptions, helper text, required/optional markers, leading/trailing affordances, clear actions, and async validation.
- Preserve web label associations, native accessibilityLabel/state, proper input/keyboard modes, autofill, secure-entry behavior where needed, selection and composition/IME.
- Document locale-aware display versus parsing, precision/rounding contracts, and submit/cancel behavior without including app business validation in core.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] React and RN examples show visible labels and accessible error/helper associations; placeholders are never the only label.
- [ ] Validation, focus, blur, submission, disabled/read-only, long text, and error recovery work with keyboard and screen readers.
- [ ] IME composition, pasted/negative/decimal amounts, locale separators, and native keyboard avoidance have verified behavior.
- [ ] Formatting does not silently change raw financial values or precision, and form libraries remain optional integrations.

## Prerequisites

- #13 — Build Bloxwap action and surface primitives for React and RN

## References

- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)
- [Pro](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/pro/src/components/ui)
- [Font](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Plain](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/plain-ui)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Build text input and form-field primitives for React and RN
